svg.title: Shop Bot: digital commerce on telegram
svg.desc: Sell digital products inside Telegram, paid in Stars and delivered once per payment. Sell digital products where customers already are, take payment in Telegram Stars, and deliver exactly what was paid for, once, with a record of every charge, delivery, and refund. Workflow: Customer checks out, then Signed Stars invoice, then Pre-checkout check, then Telegram charges Stars, then Receipt on the ledger, then Files and keys delivered.
